name: Foodics MCP
description:
Foodics is the restaurant operating system F&B businesses across the Middle East and North Africa offering point of sale, payments, inventory, and back-office in one platform.

The Foodics MCP connector lets you ask questions about your own restaurant data in plain language, in English or Arabic, without writing a query or exporting a report. Connect once and Claude can pull from:


No API key is required : authentication happens through your existing Foodics account, and the connector is read-only, so Claude can analyse your data but never change it. Access is scoped to the account you sign in with.

Server URL: https://mcp.foodics.com/mcp

Foodics MCP includes a limited number of questions per period. For the full analytics experience, see Foodics AI.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Foodics MCP to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Foodics MCP to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.foodics.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Foodics MCP MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Foodics MCP lists 92 MCP tools, including get_allergen, get_branch, get_business_days_report, get_category, get_combo, get_cost_adjustment, get_cost_adjustment_history_report, get_cost_analysis_report, get_coupon, get_customer, get_customer_insights_report, and get_customer_orders.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Foodics MCP?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Foodics MCP in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.

_published_faq.name: Does Foodics MCP MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Foodics MCP requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Foodics MCP is developed by Foodics. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
